dominant_strengths: Iconic SF Pro headline at massive scale anchors the page with confident, unmistakable Apple typographic hierarchy
Sub-nav icon row is meticulously crafted with consistent silhouettes, creating an efficient model selector
Product photography is hero-grade: clean cutouts, vivid watch faces, and balanced color stories per tile
dominant_weaknesses: Three product tiles compete equally for attention with no clear primary, flattening the narrative hierarchy
The promo bar feels visually disconnected — gray slab interrupts the white canvas without elegant transition
Composition leans on template familiarity; little distinctiveness beyond standard Apple grid conventions
fix_priorities: Establish a dominant hero tile (likely Series 11) with scale or motion to break the equal-weight triptych
Integrate the Fitness+ promo more gracefully — tighter type, refined divider, or inline placement
Add subtle motion or parallax cues on watch faces to elevate visceral impact beyond static product shots
Differentiate sub-nav icon treatment so 'New' Bands and current models get stronger visual priority
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral clarity and solid visceral polish, but reflective resonance is muted by formulaic, template-driven layout.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it cleanly fulfills the Apple Watch landing page brief with category navigation and product entry points, though it plays it safe.
